verdict.rationale: Airwallex's first-party AgentOS lets users operate their production account in natural language through AI agents. It bundles a hosted MCP server, the CLI, pre-built skills (beneficiary creation, card provisioning, cashflow reports, contract-to-billing) and one-step plugins for Claude Code, Cowork and Cursor, so agents can run multi-step financial workflows on the user's behalf. Natural-language operation depends on a third-party agent client, and money-out actions are disabled by default. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documented coverage of money-movement actions via agents, independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works as claimed.
